title: Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (cflt-prefixed): must not be flagged (tool-corroborated)
summary: 3 inputs related to Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (cflt-prefixed) that resemble the format but are not issued credentials (a bare prefix, a short body, a mask or a reference).
rationale: A value that only resembles a credential is not one. Reporting it is a false alarm, and it shows whether structure and context, not appearance, decide the outcome.

expectation.rationale: Malformed-by-construction control: prefix-only, truncated, mis-delimited or public-material shape of a contracted family. Expected silence follows from construction.
